title: Dolly's Bargain Store
description:
Originally built in 1958 as a local grocery store, this property served the community until the late 1980s. After sitting abandoned for decades, it was renovated in 2021 into a Dolly Parton-themed Western retreat with lots of rustic charm!

Enjoy a cozy getaway, with live horses grazing in the backyard. Located in Middle Tennessee, this property offers easy access to major cities, with shopping, dining, and entertainment within 15 minutes. A perfect blend of comfort, character, and convenience

The space
Welcome to your ultimate Western-themed getaway with a touch of Dolly charm! This cozy retreat blends rustic style with modern comforts, perfect for a relaxing escape. Inside, you’ll find two inviting bedrooms, each with a queen-sized bed and TV, ensuring a restful stay. The spacious open floor plan connects the living room and fully equipped kitchen, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The bathroom features a luxurious three-head shower, giving you a spa-like experience after a day of adventure.

But the magic doesn’t stop there—friendly horses in the back will be there to greet you as you pull up, adding to the charm of this countryside escape. With a little sparkle of Dolly-inspired flair, this one-of-a-kind stay is as cozy, fun, and fabulous as the queen of country herself!

Other things to note
Things to Do in Mt. Juliet & Surrounding Areas:
	•	Percy Priest Lake & Long Hunter State Park – Enjoy boating, fishing, hiking, and scenic lake views.
	•	Cedar Creek Recreation Area – A great spot for swimming, picnicking, and camping.
	•	Charlie Daniels Park – A family-friendly park with walking trails, playgrounds, and sports courts.
	•	Providence Marketplace – A top shopping and dining destination with a variety of restaurants, boutiques, and entertainment options.
	•	Fiddlers Grove Historic Village – Step back in time and explore preserved historic buildings from the region.

Things to Do in Downtown Nashville (About 30-40 Minutes Away):
	•	Broadway Honky Tonks – Experience live country music at legendary bars like Tootsie’s Orchid Lounge and The Stage.
	•	Country Music Hall of Fame & Ryman Auditorium – Dive into the rich history of country music and tour iconic venues.
	•	The Grand Ole Opry – Catch a live performance at the world-famous home of country music.
	•	Johnny Cash Museum & National Museum of African American Music – Explore exhibits dedicated to legendary artists and musical history.
	•	The Gulch & 12 South – Discover trendy boutiques, murals, and upscale dining.
	•	Bicentennial Capitol Mall State Park – Walk through Tennessee’s history with scenic views and monuments.

With a mix of outdoor adventures, historic sites, live music, and great food, there’s something for everyone to enjoy during their stay!
